content.short: Sharl puts the meme into memecoin.
content.description:
Sharl is a community take over success and first if its kind on Cardano. Not only did the community see the sheer meme-ability of Sharl but also went on to go novel ways for a memecoin by securing 50% of the trading pool on minswap into a multi-sig wallet with signees such as Fettuccine and Bullishalex. Why burn the only true workhorse if there are other ways to build trust? The original LP was completely burned by the unknown founder which left the community with no presale or tokenomics.

Everything was bought and deployed from the open market.
